diagnostics.message: The Shared VPC service-project attachment uses the Compute API but has no ordering edge to the project service enablement. Enablement must complete before creating this association; add an explicit dependency on the project services.

This subnet IAM grant can include service-agent principals, but it does not wait for project service activation as the parallel project-level Shared VPC robot IAM grant does. Ensure APIs are enabled before applying the subnet IAM grant.

This subnet IAM grant can name Google-managed service agents, but it does not wait for service identity creation. Add the ordering dependency used by the corresponding project-level Shared VPC robot IAM grant.

The parallel project-level Shared VPC robot IAM grant waits for default service-account configuration before granting access; this subnet IAM grant can race that operation when it includes managed service-agent principals.

This subnet IAM grant may include the BigQuery service agent, but it does not wait for the BigQuery default service-account lookup that the corresponding project-level Shared VPC robot grant uses to ensure that identity is available.

This subnet IAM grant may include the Cloud Storage service agent, but it does not wait for the Storage project service-account lookup that the corresponding project-level Shared VPC robot grant uses to ensure that identity is available.
